repos.readme_summary: # Impeccable The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with `polish` and `bolder`, review with `critique` and `audit`, and catch AI slop before it ships. From your project root: ```bash npx impeccable install ``` Reload your coding tool, then run `/impeccable init` in your agent (`$impeccable init` on Codex). Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Devin, Replit Agent, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, Kiro, Trae, Rovo Dev, Qoder, Mistral Vibe, Pi, Hermes Agent, DeepSeek Harness, and Veto.
